purpose: Twenty-first-pass official and first-party verification for eight existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator pages, Companies House records and official local-authority planning or service routes are promoted. Directory-only claims and inferred lease completion are rejected.
method.current_status_policy: A current operator page, active company record or council service route verifies identity or activity only; it does not prove executed lease terms, legal completion, occupational rights or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
